integrity.claim_scope: One two-particle cube-graph representation classification and its finite-quotient consequences.
integrity.computational_check: Standalone script reconstructs all cells and signs, verifies exact integer ranks and independently reduces mod two, and checks all 48 chain actions.

scientific_limitations: All homology representations and quotient claims use rational coefficients; integral H1 torsion and integral representation lattices are not classified.
No conclusion for higher-dimensional cubes or more particles.
Unindexed mathematically equivalent work cannot be excluded; related stable-representation paper available at abstract level only.
title: Full cubic symmetry on two-particle configuration homology of the three-cube
